Rule: prefer a leftover that is a whole multiple of the item size (0, item, 2item: room for whole copies of this item), even over a tight non-exact fit; avoid leftovers smaller than the item. Probes: picks gap=item over gap=2 (8/8) and 2*item over item+1 (8/8). No corpus or literature equivalent known to the reader; the 'avoid gap < item' part is the ab principle.
